column1: # One layout per line, five fields separated by a TAB:
#   id           the console keymap's name (/usr/share/keymaps/<id>.map, what
#                loadkeys takes): xkb_layout, or xkb_layout-xkb_variant, in
#   name         what Settings shows for the layout
#   language     the language(s) it is for, Settings' second line
#   xkb_layout   the XKB layout and variant of xkeyboard-config that the X
#   xkb_variant  session loads (setxkbmap) and the console keymap is made
#                from; the variant is empty for a layout's default
# Ordered by name.  The console keymaps are generated from this file at image
# build time (host/gen-keymaps.pl), so a line added here gets its keymap.
